sn38.4:1.1: kimatthiyaṃ āvuso sāriputta, samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
sn38.4:1.2: dukkhassa kho āvuso, pariññatthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
sn38.4:1.3: atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa dukkhassa pariññāyāti.
sn38.4:1.4: atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa dukkhassa pariññāyāti.
sn38.4:1.5: katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etassa dukkhassa pariññāyāti.
sn38.4:2.1: ayameva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo etassa dukkhassa pariññāya, seyyathidaṃ:
sn38.4:2.3: ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā etassa dukkhassa pariññāyāti.
sn38.4:2.4: bhaddako āvuso maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etassa dukkhassa pariññāya.
